cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务部的《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway. We're recording this at 14:00 GMT on Wednesday, the 23rd of September.
cues.zh: 你好，我是奥利弗·康韦。现在是格林尼治时间9月23日星期三14点，我们正在录制本节目。

cues.en: Gunmen kill 11 people at a house party near Durban as South Africa struggles to combat violent crime.
cues.zh: 南非努力打击暴力犯罪之际，枪手在德班附近一场聚会上杀死11人。

cues.en: Fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia as Tigrayan fighters battle government forces. And the head of the IMF warns advanced economies to reduce their debt burdens.
cues.zh: 提格雷武装与政府军交战，人们担心埃塞俄比亚会重返内战。国际货币基金组织负责人警告发达经济体降低债务负担。

cues.en: And the archaeologists hoping to search for the tomb of Egyptian Queen Nefertiti.
cues.zh: 还将报道希望寻找埃及女王奈菲尔提蒂陵墓的考古学家。

cues.en: South Africa has one of the highest murder rates in the world, with around 60 people killed every day.
cues.zh: 南非是世界上谋杀率最高的国家之一，每天约有60人被杀。

cues.en: In one particularly deadly incident on Tuesday night, gunmen attacked a house party in a township outside Durban, killing 11 people, including a pregnant woman.
cues.zh: 周二晚一起特别致命的事件中，枪手袭击了德班郊外小镇的一场聚会，造成11人死亡，其中包括一名孕妇。

cues.en: I heard more from our correspondent in Johannesburg, Pumza Fihlani.
cues.zh: 我从驻约翰内斯堡记者普姆扎·菲赫拉尼那里了解了更多情况。

cues.en: The police have said, Oliver, that it's still very early in their investigation, but they are also following a lead.
cues.zh: 奥利弗，警方表示调查还处于非常早期阶段，但他们也在追查一条线索。

cues.en: Some of the victims, they say, had been on their crime watchlist.
cues.zh: 据警方称，部分受害者曾在警方的犯罪监视名单上。

cues.en: They are saying this may mean that there was a rival feud involved that was behind the killing.
cues.zh: 他们说，这可能意味着此次杀戮背后存在敌对争斗。

cues.en: It's something that's not that widely common in South Africa, mass shootings.
cues.zh: 大规模枪击在南非并不常见。

cues.en: Although the murder rate is high, it does still shock a lot of people in this country to see mass shootings happen anywhere.
cues.zh: 虽然谋杀率很高，但看到任何地方发生大规模枪击，仍会让这个国家的许多人感到震惊。

cues.en: But KZN, KwaZulu-Natal, that area where that happened in, there's just another insight that's important to share there.
cues.zh: 但在发生枪击的夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省，还有一个重要情况值得分享。

cues.en: It's a place where murder for hire is rife, the police have said, so they're also looking at whether that was behind the motive.
cues.zh: 警方说，这里雇凶杀人现象猖獗，因此他们也在调查这是否是作案动机。

cues.en: Whether somebody paid these gunmen to carry out the shooting last night.
cues.zh: 也就是是否有人付钱让这些枪手实施昨晚的枪击。

cues.en: Yeah, and tell us more about the high levels of violent crime that are affecting South Africa at the moment.
cues.zh: 那么，请再谈谈目前影响南非的高水平暴力犯罪。

cues.en: Certainly, it has one of the highest violent crime rates in the world.
cues.zh: 当然，南非的暴力犯罪率位居世界最高之列。

cues.en: The murder rate continues to be something that's very difficult for the authorities, from the government to the police, to get a handle on.
cues.zh: 谋杀率持续成为政府到警方都难以控制的问题。

cues.en: It's something that South Africans are widely concerned about, and that prosecution rate, they've said, isn't as high as it can be.
cues.zh: 南非人普遍对此感到担忧，他们说，检控率并没有达到应有的水平。

cues.en: It takes very long for cases to get through the courts, and in some instances for even arrests to happen.
cues.zh: 案件进入法院需要很长时间，有些情况下甚至要等很久才会逮捕。

cues.en: But it is something that is front of mind for a lot of South Africans because of how prevalent it is and just how widespread.
cues.zh: 但这是许多南非人最关心的问题，因为它如此普遍、影响如此广泛。

cues.en: There isn't one specific area, Oliver, that you can zero in on and say if we solve it here, it goes away everywhere.
cues.zh: 奥利弗，这并非某一个具体地区的问题，你不能说只要在这里解决，其他地方就会消失。

cues.en: It happens in each province and for various reasons.
cues.zh: 它在每个省都会发生，原因也各不相同。

cues.en: But the police have said that they are trying their level best in terms of renewing their training.
cues.zh: 但警方表示，他们正在尽最大努力更新培训。

cues.en: And getting as much resources as needed so they can get a handle on the situation.
cues.zh: 并获得所需的资源，以控制住局面。

cues.en: Yeah, the government even sent in the army earlier this year.
cues.zh: 是的，政府甚至在今年早些时候派遣了军队。

cues.en: Is there anything more they can do?
cues.zh: 还有什么他们能做的吗？

cues.en: That should tell you how serious of a problem it is.
cues.zh: 这应该告诉你问题有多严重。

cues.en: We don't see the army on the streets of South Africa often. They only are ever called in when there's been a spike, really, and they're there to help the police effect arrests.
cues.zh: 我们很少在南非街头看到军队。只有在犯罪激增时，他们才会被召集来帮助警方实施逮捕。

cues.en: So they don't effect arrests themselves, but they're there as extra backup.
cues.zh: 他们自己不执行逮捕，而是作为额外支援。

cues.en: There are certain parts of the country where even the police themselves cannot just willingly go in.
cues.zh: 因为该国一些地区连警方都不能随意进入。

cues.en: They need that added support in terms of gunfire. And we see in areas where that does happen, there is temporarily a reduction of violent crime.
cues.zh: 他们需要这种额外的火力支援。在确实发生这种情况的地区，我们看到暴力犯罪暂时减少。

cues.en: Pumza Fihlani in Johannesburg.
cues.zh: 约翰内斯堡的普姆扎·菲赫拉尼。

cues.en: The head of the International Monetary Fund has warned advanced economies to cut their borrowing.
cues.zh: 国际货币基金组织负责人警告，发达经济体应削减借款。

cues.en: Kristalina Georgieva said debt levels had been pushed up by global shocks,
cues.zh: 克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃说，全球冲击推高了债务水平，

cues.en: but governments hadn't done enough to tackle the spiralling cost of interest.
cues.zh: 但各国政府还没有采取足够措施，应对不断攀升的利息成本。

cues.en: She spoke to our economics editor Faisal Islam at the UN General Assembly.
cues.zh: 她在联合国大会期间接受了本台经济编辑费萨尔·伊斯兰的采访。

cues.en: Our message to everybody is: you cannot control exogenous factors,
cues.zh: 我们要传达给所有人的信息是：你们无法控制外部因素，

cues.en: but you have control over your domestic policies.
cues.zh: 但你们可以控制自己的国内政策。

cues.en: So make sure you stay ahead of inflation, keep inflation back,
cues.zh: 所以要确保走在通胀前面，把通胀压下去，

cues.en: and governments need to get on top of their debt issue.
cues.zh: 各国政府还需要妥善处理债务问题。

cues.en: I have seen shock after shock pushing debt levels up like a staircase,
cues.zh: 我看到一次又一次的冲击，把债务水平像楼梯一样推高，

cues.en: not to heaven, and no action to contain the debt-service costs.
cues.zh: 它并没有通向天堂，而且没有采取行动控制债务偿付成本。

cues.en: So time to take that action.
cues.zh: 所以，是时候采取行动了。

cues.en: You are the world's financial and fiscal watchdog.
cues.zh: 你们是全世界的金融和财政监督者。

cues.en: You mark the homework, if you like, of entire governments, especially at times like this.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意这么说，你们是在给各国政府批改作业，尤其是在这样的时刻。

cues.en: There's been a government bond-market borrowing shock, frankly, over the summer, affecting the biggest nations in the world.
cues.zh: 坦率地说，今年夏天政府债券市场出现了借款冲击，影响了世界上最大的几个国家。

cues.en: The policy advice you're saying quite clearly is to respond to this shock with lower borrowing,
cues.zh: 你明确提出的政策建议是，以减少借款来应对这次冲击，

cues.en: potentially lower spending, potentially tax rises?
cues.zh: 也可以减少支出，或者提高税收？

cues.en: So there are these two things that must be done:
cues.zh: 所以有两件事必须做到：

cues.en: bring debt levels down, put fiscal consolidation as a priority,
cues.zh: 降低债务水平，把财政整顿放在首位，

cues.en: and make sure that the central banks deliver on their mandate for price stability.
cues.zh: 并确保各国央行履行维持价格稳定的职责。

cues.en: IMF boss Kristalina Georgieva.
cues.zh: 国际货币基金组织负责人克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃。

cues.en: Listening to that was our business reporter Ijeoma Ndukaife.
cues.zh: 本台商业记者伊杰奥玛·恩杜凯费听取了这段采访。

cues.en: I asked her first why debt costs were so high at the moment.
cues.zh: 我先问她，为什么目前债务成本如此之高。

cues.en: The war in Iran has certainly exacerbated this issue because it's disrupted the supply of oil.
cues.zh: 伊朗战争确实加剧了这个问题，因为它扰乱了石油供应。

cues.en: Of course, we've been hearing so much about the Strait of Hormuz and its blockade,
cues.zh: 当然，我们一直听到许多关于霍尔木兹海峡及其封锁的消息，

cues.en: and because it's restricted the flow of oil reaching international markets, that in turn has fuelled inflation,
cues.zh: 由于这限制了流向国际市场的石油，这又推高了通胀，

cues.en: which means government borrowing costs have gone up.
cues.zh: 这意味着政府的借款成本上升了。

cues.en: As you know, the government uses tools to bring down inflation, and one key tool is raising interest rates,
cues.zh: 正如你所知，政府会采取措施降低通胀，其中一个关键手段就是提高利率，

cues.en: and that makes it more expensive to borrow,
cues.zh: 这会让借款变得更加昂贵，

cues.en: and that in turn makes it more expensive for governments to service their debt.
cues.zh: 进而让政府偿还债务的成本更高。

cues.en: So, in the UK, for example, interest on government debt in August was the highest figure
cues.zh: 例如在英国，8月的政府债务利息达到最高值，

cues.en: since monthly records began in 1997.
cues.zh: 是自1997年开始按月记录以来的最高水平。

cues.en: And just looking at the US, another advanced economy, borrowing costs pushed up debt to more than
cues.zh: 再看美国这个发达经济体，借款成本把债务推高到超过

cues.en: $40 trillion, which has doubled in the space of a decade.
cues.zh: 40万亿美元；这在十年间翻了一倍。

cues.en: Okay, so a lot of interest that has to be paid.
cues.zh: 好，也就是说有大量利息需要支付。

cues.en: How can governments bring that down and will they take action?
cues.zh: 政府如何降低这些成本？它们会采取行动吗？

cues.en: I think one of the things that Ms Georgieva alluded to is this difficulty
cues.zh: 我认为，格奥尔基耶娃女士提到的问题之一，就是这种困难

cues.en: politically with trying to cut spending. I mean, what do governments cut?
cues.zh: 在政治上削减支出很困难。我的意思是，政府要削减什么？

cues.en: Here in the UK, we're expecting Prime Minister Andy Burnham's first budget next month,
cues.zh: 在英国，我们预计首相安迪·伯纳姆的首份预算将在下月公布，

cues.en: and speculation is already building over his tax policy and what spending policies will be.
cues.zh: 外界已经开始猜测他的税收政策和支出政策会是什么。

cues.en: I mean, the key thing here is that governments need to bring down their debt levels, and to do that, they have to cut government spending.
cues.zh: 关键在于，各国政府需要降低债务水平，而这就必须削减政府支出。

cues.en: She also talked about central banks stabilizing prices, which could mean raising interest even further, which isn't popular.
cues.zh: 她还谈到央行稳定价格，这可能意味着进一步加息，而这并不受欢迎。

cues.en: That means mortgage rates going up even more.
cues.zh: 这意味着抵押贷款利率还会进一步上升。

cues.en: Another mechanism is policy reform that encourages
cues.zh: 另一个办法是通过政策改革，鼓励

cues.en: the private sector to come in and invest, because governments simply don't have the cash to boost economic growth.
cues.zh: 私营部门进入并投资，因为政府根本没有资金推动经济增长。

cues.en: The IMF boss also warned about AI, huge amounts of investment going in, and the possible disruption it can cause.
cues.zh: 国际货币基金组织负责人还警告了人工智能：大量资金正在涌入，而它可能造成颠覆性影响。

cues.en: How worried should we be that a possible AI bubble could burst?
cues.zh: 我们应该多担心人工智能泡沫可能破裂？

cues.en: There are still concerns that companies might not—you know, investors might not realize
cues.zh: 人们仍担心企业可能——你知道，投资者可能无法实现

cues.en: the returns expected from investment in artificial intelligence,
cues.zh: 人工智能投资所预期的回报，

cues.en: because we've been seeing so much money funneled into developing the infrastructure,
cues.zh: 因为我们看到大量资金被投入基础设施建设，

cues.en: building things like data centers.
cues.zh: 比如建设数据中心。

cues.en: So there are concerns that perhaps the industry has exaggerated their abilities to boost their performance and profit.
cues.zh: 所以有人担心，这个行业或许夸大了自身提升表现和利润的能力。

cues.en: That's something we'll have to wait and see. Business reporter Ijeoma Ndukaife.
cues.zh: 这还有待观察。本台商业记者伊杰奥玛·恩杜凯费。

cues.en: Barbie, Saltburn, and Thelma and Louise, all successful films, all written by women.
cues.zh: 《芭比》《萨特本》和《末路狂花》都是成功的电影，也都是由女性编写的。

cues.en: A study analysing almost 200,000 films across three decades has found that productions with female screenwriters made higher profits
cues.zh: 一项分析三十年间近20万部电影的研究发现，有女性编剧参与的作品利润更高，

cues.en: and yet women remain underrepresented among filmmakers.
cues.zh: 然而，女性在电影制作人中仍然比例不足。

cues.en: Ella Bicknell has the details.
cues.zh: 埃拉·比克内尔报道详情。

cues.en: Frozen, Avatar: The Way of Water, and Mamma Mia.
cues.zh: 《冰雪奇缘》《阿凡达：水之道》和《妈妈咪呀》。

cues.en: Blockbuster films with one thing in common: they were written or directed by women.
cues.zh: 这些大片有一个共同点：由女性编写或执导。

cues.en: But such films remain a minority.
cues.zh: 但这样的电影仍占少数。

cues.en: Just 27% of those made over the past 30 years had a female director or screenwriter.
cues.zh: 过去30年制作的电影中，只有27%有女性导演或编剧。

cues.en: Researchers at the University of Mainz in Germany analysed earnings from the Internet Movie Database, known as IMDb, and concluded
cues.zh: 德国美因茨大学的研究人员分析了互联网电影数据库（IMDb）的收益，并得出结论：

cues.en: there was no financial logic to the disparity.
cues.zh: 这种差异没有财务上的合理性。

cues.en: Among films with similar budgets, those written by women generated 34% higher median profits than those with all-male writing and directing teams.
cues.zh: 在预算相近的电影中，女性编剧创作的作品，其利润中位数比全男性编剧和导演团队的作品高34%。

cues.en: Greta Gerwig's Barbie is one example, taking almost $1.5 billion at the global box office, 2023's highest-grossing film.
cues.zh: 格蕾塔·葛韦格的《芭比》就是一例，全球票房近15亿美元，是2023年票房最高的电影。

cues.en: If I may be so honoured, to have all the female nominees in every category stand with me in this room tonight.
cues.zh: 如果允许我这样说，我想请今晚在场的各类别女性提名者都站到我身边。

cues.en: The filmmakers, the producers, at the 2018 Oscars, Frances McDormand used her best actress speech to call for greater inclusion.
cues.zh: 在2018年奥斯卡颁奖礼上，演员弗朗西斯·麦克多蒙德在最佳女演员获奖感言中呼吁扩大包容。

cues.en: Look around, ladies and gentlemen, because we all have stories to tell and projects we need finance.
cues.zh: 女士们、先生们，请看看周围，因为我们都有故事要讲，也有项目需要资金。

cues.en: The number of female directors and writers has grown in recent decades,
cues.zh: 近几十年来，女性导演和编剧的数量有所增加，

cues.en: but the researchers behind this latest analysis say risk-averse studio financing is enforcing the status quo, even when there's more money to be made.
cues.zh: 但这项最新分析的研究人员说，即使有更多赚钱机会，规避风险的制片厂融资仍在维持现状。

cues.en: Ella Bicknell.
cues.zh: 埃拉·比克内尔。

cues.en: Archaeologists are trying to get permission to drill into the rock next to the tomb of Tutankhamun.
cues.zh: 考古学家正试图获准在图坦卡蒙墓旁的岩石上钻孔。

cues.en: After new surveys suggested there may be other structures hidden behind it.
cues.zh: 新的勘测显示，墓后可能还隐藏着其他结构。

cues.en: They hope the chambers may house the tomb of the Egyptian Queen Nefertiti.
cues.zh: 他们希望这些墓室里可能安葬着埃及女王奈菲尔提蒂。

cues.en: When Tutankhamun's tomb was found more than a century ago, it contained remarkable treasures.
cues.zh: 图坦卡蒙的墓在一个多世纪前被发现时，里面藏有非凡的宝藏。

cues.en: The archaeologist Howard Carter described the moment of discovery to the BBC.
cues.zh: 考古学家霍华德·卡特向 BBC 描述了发现墓穴的那一刻。

cues.en: Light shone into the sarcophagus. A gasp of wonderment escaped our lips.
cues.zh: 光线照进石棺，我们不禁惊叹出声。

cues.en: So gorgeous was the sight that met our eyes.
cues.zh: 映入眼帘的景象美得令人惊叹。

cues.en: This was but the lid of a series of three coffins.
cues.zh: 这只是一组三层棺椁的棺盖。

cues.en: Nested one within the other, enclosing the mortal remains of the young King Tutankhamun.
cues.zh: 棺椁层层相套，里面安放着年轻的图坦卡蒙王的遗骸。

cues.en: Howard Carter in 1936.
cues.zh: 霍华德·卡特，1936年。

cues.en: Bettany Hughes is a historian and author of a new book about Egypt called A History of Egypt in Seven Treasures.
cues.zh: 贝塔尼·休斯是历史学家，也是新书《埃及史：七件珍宝》的作者。

cues.en: Sarah Montague asked her if she was excited about this new endeavour.
cues.zh: 萨拉·蒙塔古问她是否对这项新探索感到兴奋。

cues.en: I have to say I am constantly excited when it comes to ancient Egypt.
cues.zh: 我得说，只要谈到古埃及，我总是感到兴奋。

cues.en: There is definitely something interesting going on here at the back of Tutankhamun's tomb.
cues.zh: 图坦卡蒙墓的后方确实有一些有趣的情况。

cues.en: I really just want to qualify: we have no idea whether or not it's Queen Nefertiti.
cues.zh: 我必须强调，我们完全不知道那里是否是奈菲尔提蒂的墓。

cues.en: That was something that was posited around ten years ago.
cues.zh: 这种说法大约在十年前就有人提出过。

cues.en: It's not impossible, but what is more exciting is that it looks like there are chambers and corridors behind Tutankhamun's resting place.
cues.zh: 这并非不可能；更令人兴奋的是，图坦卡蒙安息之所后方似乎有墓室和走廊。

cues.en: And did we not know that before?
cues.zh: 我们以前不知道这一点吗？

cues.en: No, we didn't. We didn't. I mean, this is as a result of lots of very cutting-edge techniques.
cues.zh: 不知道。以前确实不知道。这是许多尖端技术带来的结果。

cues.en: So it's thermal imaging, ground-penetrating radar, geological mapping, tomography.
cues.zh: 包括热成像、探地雷达、地质测绘和断层扫描。

cues.en: So that means that the team working in the tomb have worked out it's not sheer bedrock behind the west wall of the tomb.
cues.zh: 这意味着，在墓中工作的团队已经确定，墓室西墙后面并非坚硬的基岩。

cues.en: But there is some kind of ancient structure there.
cues.zh: 那里确实存在某种古代建筑结构。

cues.en: And what's brilliant now is that because we can use all these new techniques.
cues.zh: 现在最棒的是，我们可以运用所有这些新技术。

cues.en: You can do this kind of work in a completely non-invasive way.
cues.zh: 我们可以用完全无损的方式进行这类工作。

cues.en: So you're not chiselling through the back of the beautiful decorations surrounding his sarcophagus.
cues.zh: 所以，不必凿穿环绕他石棺的精美装饰。

cues.en: So there is something interesting there. You know, surely.
cues.zh: 所以那里确实有些有趣的东西。你看，肯定是这样。

cues.en: Ultimately you do need to sort of make a hole and go in. Not, you know, this is the genius, Sarah. You don't need to now.
cues.zh: 不过归根结底，你还是得凿个洞进去吧。不必——这正是高明之处，萨拉。现在不用了。

cues.en: So we can now unwrap whole mummified bodies and look at the amulets left inside the bodies without raising a single bandage.
cues.zh: 现在我们可以解开完整的木乃伊，查看尸体里的护身符，连一条绷带都不用揭开。

cues.en: It's the polar opposite of dear Howard Carter and Lord Carnarvon when they did their work 100 years ago.
cues.zh: 这与亲爱的霍华德·卡特和卡那封勋爵一百年前的做法截然相反。

cues.en: They basically ripped it all apart. So no, no, no, that's what's truly exciting.
cues.zh: 他们当时基本上把一切都拆开了。所以不、不、不，真正令人兴奋的正是这一点。

cues.en: You've just been talking about artificial intelligence, and this is a way that we can use artificial intelligence.
cues.zh: 你刚才一直在谈人工智能，而我们可以用人工智能。

cues.en: To uncover ancestral intelligence in these tombs.
cues.zh: 去揭开这些墓穴中的祖先智慧。

cues.en: So it really could be possible that this is discovered completely remotely without moving a single brick.
cues.zh: 所以，确实有可能完全远程发现这一切，不必移动一块砖。

cues.en: Okay, and you might think this is a bit cheap, but Tutankhamun's tomb, didn't it have an enormous amount of gold treasures inside it?
cues.zh: 好吧，你可能觉得这样问有点俗，但图坦卡蒙墓里不是有大量黄金宝藏吗？

cues.en: And aren't people going to be excited at that prospect?
cues.zh: 想到这一点，人们不是会很兴奋吗？

cues.en: Oh, 100%. I mean, Tutankhamun's tomb had, at the latest count, 5,398 treasures within it.
cues.zh: 当然，百分之百。我是说，按最近统计，图坦卡蒙墓里有5398件宝物。

cues.en: So there was exquisite gold, and there were beautiful games that he used to play with as a child.
cues.zh: 里面有精美的黄金，还有他小时候玩过的漂亮玩具。

cues.en: Incredibly touching: his little socks with toes stitched in, duck lunch boxes in case he needed a snack on his way to the afterlife.
cues.zh: 还有令人动容的物品：缝出脚趾的小袜子，以及他去往来世途中用来装零食的鸭形午餐盒。

cues.en: So, I mean, it was, you know, it was the most astonishing find.
cues.zh: 所以，那真是最令人惊叹的发现。

cues.en: And of course, if there is something new in the Valley of the Kings, it will be game-changing and history-making.
cues.zh: 当然，如果帝王谷有新的发现，那将改变游戏规则，也会载入史册。

cues.en: We just don't know whether it's Nefertiti.
cues.zh: 我们只是还不知道那是否是奈菲尔提蒂。

cues.en: That's Bettany Hughes talking to Sarah Montague.
cues.zh: 这是贝塔尼·休斯接受萨拉·蒙塔古采访。

cues.en: And still to come on this podcast, this planet has literally just formed.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还将介绍一颗刚刚形成的行星。

cues.en: We normally can't see planets until they're about 10 million years old.
cues.zh: 通常要等行星形成约一千万年后，我们才能看见它们。

cues.en: It tells us so much about planet formation: the youngest planet ever discovered.
cues.zh: 这将告诉我们许多关于行星形成的事情——这是迄今发现的最年轻行星。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Reports from Ethiopia say local forces in the northern region of Tigray have seized the airport in the regional capital, Mekelle.
cues.zh: 来自埃塞俄比亚的报道说，北部提格雷地区的地方武装已夺取地区首府默克莱的机场。

cues.en: The Tigrayan rebels said they were combating an invasion by federal forces, raising fears of a resumption of the two-year civil war in the area
cues.zh: 提格雷叛军称，他们正在抵抗联邦军队的入侵，引发人们对该地区两年内战可能重燃的担忧，

cues.en: which left as many as 600,000 people dead.
cues.zh: 那场内战造成多达60万人死亡。

cues.en: Catherine Byaruhanga got the latest from our former Ethiopia correspondent, Kalkidan Yibeltal.
cues.zh: 凯瑟琳·拜亚鲁汉加请我们前埃塞俄比亚记者卡尔基丹·伊贝尔塔尔介绍最新情况。

cues.en: All flights to and from Tigrayan cities have been suspended.
cues.zh: 往返提格雷城市的所有航班均已暂停。

cues.en: The flag carrier Ethiopian Airlines announced this morning that they have suspended all flights to the three major airports in the Tigray region.
cues.zh: 埃塞俄比亚的旗舰航空公司埃塞俄比亚航空今天早上宣布，已暂停飞往提格雷地区三座主要机场的所有航班。

cues.en: And, you know, local sources and residents in the city told us that Tigrayan forces have entered into the main airport in Mekelle city
cues.zh: 当地消息人士和该市居民告诉我们，提格雷武装已经进入默克莱市的主机场，

cues.en: and, you know, taking control of it.
cues.zh: 并控制了那里。

cues.en: That airport had been under the control of a few federal police forces, and it's not clear what happened to these federal police forces.
cues.zh: 那座机场此前由少数联邦警察部队控制，但目前不清楚这些联邦警察部队发生了什么。

cues.en: But this signals a major escalation, and it's coming in the backdrop of recent weeks of increasing tensions and increasing instances of drone strikes in Tigray
cues.zh: 但这标志着局势大幅升级，背景是最近几周提格雷地区的紧张局势加剧、无人机袭击次数增加，

cues.en: and around Tigray region.
cues.zh: 以及提格雷地区周边。

cues.en: And also it happens a few days after seven rebel armed groups have announced that they're forming an alliance
cues.zh: 此外，这发生在七个叛军武装团体宣布组建联盟几天之后，

cues.en: in an effort to try to overthrow the government of Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed.
cues.zh: 它们试图推翻总理阿比·艾哈迈德领导的政府。

cues.en: And just give us the context of this and why it's so worrying
cues.zh: 请介绍一下这件事的背景，以及它为何令人如此担忧，

cues.en: because this comes some four years after the civil war in Tigray, where hundreds of thousands of people were killed.
cues.zh: 因为这距离提格雷内战已经过去大约四年，那场战争造成数十万人死亡。

cues.en: This was a brutal conflict.
cues.zh: 那是一场残酷的冲突。

cues.en: Yes, it was indeed a brutal conflict
cues.zh: 是的，那确实是一场残酷的冲突，

cues.en: and it's one of the most devastating and the deadliest conflicts this century anywhere.
cues.zh: 也是本世纪任何地方最具破坏性、最致命的冲突之一。

cues.en: Some estimates put the number of people who were killed in the region at 600,000.
cues.zh: 一些估计认为，该地区遇难人数达到60万。

cues.en: That was the civil war in Tigray between 2020 and 2022.
cues.zh: 那就是2020年至2022年的提格雷内战。

cues.en: But in late 2022, there was a peace deal signed between Tigrayan forces and the federal government
cues.zh: 但在2022年年底，提格雷武装与联邦政府签署了一项和平协议，

cues.en: that silenced the guns. And, you know, normal activities have resumed to the region
cues.zh: 枪声因此平息。该地区的正常活动也已经恢复，

cues.en: and it seems that things were returning back to normality.
cues.zh: 事情似乎正在恢复正常。

cues.en: However, tensions remained and there were so many unresolved issues.
cues.zh: 然而，紧张局势仍在，许多问题也没有解决。

cues.en: In other parts of Ethiopia, there are other conflicts and it seems now that we're seeing all these are converging.
cues.zh: 埃塞俄比亚其他地区也存在冲突，如今这些冲突似乎正在汇聚到一起。

cues.en: The Tigrayan forces have repeatedly accused the federal government of breaching that peace deal
cues.zh: 提格雷武装多次指责联邦政府违反和平协议，

cues.en: while the federal government says that they are the ones who are breaching the peace deal
cues.zh: 而联邦政府则称，违反和平协议的恰恰是提格雷武装，

cues.en: by trying to forge an alliance with other armed actors as well as foreign countries, particularly the northern neighbor Eritrea.
cues.zh: 因为它们正试图与其他武装力量以及外国结盟，尤其是北方邻国厄立特里亚。

cues.en: And that was, as you said, very devastating.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，那非常具有毁灭性。

cues.en: The humanitarian crisis was very consequential.
cues.zh: 人道主义危机造成了深远影响。

cues.en: And if another war of a similar scale were to break out, it's going to be very destabilizing
cues.zh: 如果再次爆发规模相近的战争，局势将极不稳定，

cues.en: not only for Ethiopia but for the Horn of Africa region,
cues.zh: 不仅会影响埃塞俄比亚，也会影响非洲之角地区，

cues.en: which, as you know, is still, you know, plagued by other conflicts, including in neighboring Sudan.
cues.zh: 那里仍饱受其他冲突困扰，包括邻国苏丹的冲突。

cues.en: Our former Ethiopia correspondent, Kalkidan Yibeltal, talking to Catherine Byaruhanga.
cues.zh: 前埃塞俄比亚记者卡尔基丹·伊贝尔塔尔接受了凯瑟琳·拜亚鲁汉加的采访。

cues.en: The civil war that Kalkidan mentioned in Sudan has also affected South Sudan, which split off 15 years ago.
cues.zh: 卡尔基丹提到的苏丹内战也影响了南苏丹；南苏丹于15年前分离出去。

cues.en: But since it gained independence, South Sudan has also suffered its own civil conflict, as well as widespread corruption and high levels of hunger.
cues.zh: 但自独立以来，南苏丹也饱受自身内乱之苦，并面临普遍腐败和严重饥饿。

cues.en: Now there is a political row in South Sudan after President Salva Kiir dissolved the government.
cues.zh: 如今，南苏丹出现政治争端；总统萨尔瓦·基尔解散了政府。

cues.en: And he removed all the vice presidents ahead of the country's first ever elections.
cues.zh: 他还在该国首次大选前撤换了所有副总统。

cues.en: His actions have been condemned by the opposition.
cues.zh: 他的行动遭到反对派谴责。

cues.en: South Sudan analyst Daniel Akech Thiong spoke to James Copnall.
cues.zh: 南苏丹问题分析师丹尼尔·阿凯奇·蒂昂接受了詹姆斯·科普纳尔的采访。

cues.en: We are watching July 2013 repeat itself.
cues.zh: 我们正看到2013年7月的情形重演。

cues.en: At that time, the president dissolved the whole cabinet.
cues.zh: 当时，总统解散了整个内阁。

cues.en: Within a few months, after exchanging harsh words with his rivals, the country went into civil war.
cues.zh: 几个月内，他与对手激烈交锋，该国便陷入内战。

cues.en: The 2018 peace agreement was the only guardrail against the absolute presidential powers hidden in the transitional constitutions of 2011.
cues.zh: 2018年和平协议，是制约2011年过渡宪法所隐藏的总统绝对权力的唯一护栏。

cues.en: So the parliament just stripped those guardrails away.
cues.zh: 因此，议会刚刚拆除了这些护栏。

cues.en: And allowed the president to legally purge his rivals and install a caretaker government of loyalists.
cues.zh: 这让总统得以合法清洗对手，并建立一个由亲信组成的看守政府。

cues.en: In a badly divided country.
cues.zh: 而这个国家已经严重分裂。

cues.en: So is that the concern then, a return to outright war?
cues.zh: 所以，令人担忧的是会重新陷入全面战争吗？

cues.en: Because there have been successive waves of conflict, power dynamics have shifted.
cues.zh: 因为冲突一波接一波，权力格局已经发生变化。

cues.en: You could argue the rebels are not as strong militarily as before, and people are fed up with fighting and the need for more conflict.
cues.zh: 可以说，叛军已不如从前强大，民众也厌倦了战斗，不需要更多冲突。

cues.en: You though seem to think that South Sudan could be heading back down that path.
cues.zh: 但你似乎认为，南苏丹可能正走回那条路。

cues.en: Yes, but that needs to be nuanced.
cues.zh: 是的，但这需要更细致地看。

cues.en: First is that the caretaker trap we are seeing now, it is a brilliantly engineered trap.
cues.zh: 首先，我们现在看到的看守政府陷阱，是一个精心设计的陷阱。

cues.en: That's how opposition and civil actors would see it. With absolute state control, the president's faction cannot lose even in elections.
cues.zh: 反对派和公民社会人士会这样看：总统阵营绝对控制着国家机器，即使举行选举也不会输。

cues.en: And I will say momentarily why that election might not be possible.
cues.zh: 我马上会解释为什么那场选举可能无法举行。

cues.en: And they will either push through a tightly controlled election and win it.
cues.zh: 他们要么强行推动一场严密控制的选举并赢下它。

cues.en: So that leaves no room for the opposition and other groups that want to participate in the democratic process.
cues.zh: 这就不给反对派及其他希望参与民主进程的团体留下空间。

cues.en: They could also cite logistical failures, which are known to everyone, to indefinitely extend this new loyalist mandate.
cues.zh: 他们还可以以人人都知道的后勤问题为由，无限期延长这个新的亲信政府任期。

cues.en: It is a win-win for the executive.
cues.zh: 这对行政部门来说是双赢。

cues.en: And a disaster for the transition, because it would exacerbate an existing conflict in the country, or it could make things even worse.
cues.zh: 但对过渡进程却是灾难，因为这会加剧该国已有的冲突，甚至让局势恶化。

cues.en: So that could lead to a return to more violence.
cues.zh: 所以，这可能导致暴力再次增加。

cues.en: Daniel Akech Thiong of the International Crisis Group.
cues.zh: 国际危机组织的丹尼尔·阿凯奇·蒂昂。

cues.en: When Dolly Parton died last month at the age of 80, the news was announced by her nephew Brian Seaver.
cues.zh: 多莉·帕顿上月去世，享年80岁；消息由她的侄子布赖恩·西弗宣布。

cues.en: He worked as the singer's head of security for more than two decades, taking over from his father.
cues.zh: 他担任这位歌手的安保主管超过20年，接替了自己的父亲。

cues.en: But now Dolly Parton's longtime manager has requested a restraining order against him in a growing row over the estate.
cues.zh: 但现在，多莉·帕顿的长期经理因遗产纠纷升级，申请了针对他的限制令。

cues.en: Our music correspondent Mark Savage told us more.
cues.zh: 我们的音乐记者马克·萨维奇介绍了更多情况。

cues.en: These were court papers filed in Nashville yesterday and they accuse Brian Seaver, Dolly Parton's nephew.
cues.zh: 这些是昨天在纳什维尔提交的法庭文件，指控多莉·帕顿的侄子布赖恩·西弗。

cues.en: Of what they call an intense and escalating campaign of threats against the estate.
cues.zh: 文件称，他对遗产发起了激烈且不断升级的威胁行动。

cues.en: And there are emails and text messages included in the court papers which appear to show him threatening
cues.zh: 法庭文件还收录了电子邮件和短信，看起来显示他在威胁

cues.en: Threatening the people who are looking after Dolly Parton's legacy.
cues.zh: 负责照料多莉·帕顿遗产的人。

cues.en: He says he will launch a podcast dedicated to ruining Dolly's brand.
cues.zh: 他说将推出一档专门毁掉多莉品牌的播客。

cues.en: He calls himself the hand of retribution for the Parton family and he says everyone needs to be worried.
cues.zh: 他自称帕顿家族的复仇之手，并说所有人都该担心。

cues.en: Now he has disputed his characterization in the lawsuit. He says that these messages were taken out of context and nothing that he said was a threat.
cues.zh: 现在，他否认诉讼中的这种描述。他说这些信息被断章取义，他说的没有一句是威胁。

cues.en: In a statement to TMZ, he said a lot of the messages are two guys rage talking and crying on the phone together while they were grieving.
cues.zh: 他在给TMZ的声明中说，许多信息只是两个人在哀悼时通电话，情绪激动、边哭边说。

cues.en: So what happens next?
cues.zh: 那么接下来会怎样？

cues.en: So Danny Nozell, who was Dolly Parton's manager for more than 20 years, has asked for a civil restraining order against Brian Seaver, her nephew.
cues.zh: 多莉·帕顿的经理丹尼·诺泽尔任职超过20年，已申请针对她侄子布赖恩·西弗的民事限制令。

cues.en: They've also requested a jury trial after the temporary restraining order is made in order to extend it.
cues.zh: 他们还要求陪审团审判，以便在临时限制令签发后延长其期限。

cues.en: That is of course if the restraining order is made.
cues.zh: 当然，前提是限制令获准签发。

cues.en: And they say, you know, this has affected their business already.
cues.zh: 他们说，这已经影响了他们的业务。

cues.en: They have lost lawyers and other employees.
cues.zh: 他们失去了律师和其他员工。

cues.en: As a result of what they call Seaver's threats.
cues.zh: 原因是他们所称的西弗的威胁。

cues.en: And they also say that some members of the company have had to take out private security because they're worried about their own safety.
cues.zh: 他们还说，公司一些成员因担心自身安全，不得不雇用私人保安。

cues.en: And again, I would have to say that Brian Seaver does deny that he poses a threat to these people.
cues.zh: 还要再次说明，布赖恩·西弗否认自己对这些人构成威胁。

cues.en: Of course, there was a huge outpouring of emotion when Dolly Parton died.
cues.zh: 当然，多莉·帕顿去世时引发了巨大的情感反响。

cues.en: Is this at risk of souring her legacy somewhat?
cues.zh: 这会不会让她的遗产蒙上一些阴影？

cues.en: I mean, I think, you know, obviously everybody loved Dolly Parton because she was so serene and peaceful and generous.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，大家显然都爱多莉·帕顿，因为她宁静、平和而慷慨。

cues.en: And the kind of ugliness of a family and an estate fighting over her $450 million fortune.
cues.zh: 但家人和遗产为她4.5亿美元财产争斗的丑陋，

cues.en: Is bound to sour people's opinions of those who are left to look after her legacy.
cues.zh: 势必会影响人们对留下来照料她遗产之人的看法。

cues.en: But I don't think it will make people think any worse of her.
cues.zh: 但我不认为这会让人们对她的看法变差。

cues.en: I think, you know, when money comes into families, it often turns pretty nasty.
cues.zh: 我想，金钱一旦进入家庭，事情往往会变得相当难看。

cues.en: But by all accounts, Dolly did leave her estate in such a way that there won't be a huge ongoing row.
cues.zh: 但据各方说法，多莉确实妥善安排了遗产，不会引发长期争端。

cues.en: She left a lot of her properties and a lot of her business interests in trusts, which makes the likelihood of legal action
cues.zh: 她把许多房产和商业权益置于信托中，这大大降低了采取法律行动的可能性，

cues.en: Much, much less than if she had died in probate.
cues.zh: 远低于遗产必须经过遗嘱认证程序的情况。

cues.en: BBC Music Correspondent Mark Savage.
cues.zh: BBC音乐记者马克·萨维奇。

cues.en: Astronomers have discovered the youngest planet on record.
cues.zh: 天文学家发现了有记录以来最年轻的行星。

cues.en: Four hundred and 50 light years from Earth, Elias 2-24 b is less than a million years old.
cues.zh: Elias 2-24 b距离地球450光年，形成还不到一百万年。

cues.en: Newborn planets can be difficult to find,
cues.zh: 新生行星很难被发现，

cues.en: as stars which provide the building materials are themselves born inside clouds of gas and dust.
cues.zh: 因为提供建筑材料的恒星，本身也诞生于气体和尘埃组成的云团中。

cues.en: This one could give scientists a way of studying what our own solar system may have been like billions of years ago.
cues.zh: 这颗行星或许能让科学家研究数十亿年前我们太阳系可能的样子。

cues.en: Astronomer Sarah Casewell spoke to Rick Edwards.
cues.zh: 天文学家萨拉·凯斯韦尔接受了里克·爱德华兹的采访。

cues.en: The original discovery of this planet was done through looking at the disc around this very young star.
cues.zh: 最初发现这颗行星，是通过观测这颗非常年轻的恒星周围的盘状结构。

cues.en: It's got a big disc, and we looked at the disc and we saw there were gaps in the disc,
cues.zh: 它有一个巨大的盘。我们观测这个盘，发现盘中有一些空隙，

cues.en: and those gaps are likely to be caused by a planet that's forming.
cues.zh: 这些空隙很可能是由一颗正在形成的行星造成的。

cues.en: And now people have used a technique called coronagraphy.
cues.zh: 现在，人们使用了一种叫作日冕仪观测的技术。

cues.en: They've covered up the star so they can see something that's very faint nearby,
cues.zh: 他们遮住恒星，这样就能看到附近非常微弱的东西，

cues.en: and they've seen the planet exactly where people predicted it to be.
cues.zh: 并且他们看到，行星正好位于人们预测的位置。

cues.en: This planet has literally just formed,
cues.zh: 这颗行星才刚刚形成，

cues.en: we normally can't see planets until they're about 10 million years old, and all that disc has been got rid of.
cues.zh: 我们通常要等行星形成约1000万年、周围的盘消失后，才能看到它们。

cues.en: And it tells us so much about planet formation and our model, whether our models were right.
cues.zh: 这让我们对行星形成以及模型是否正确有了更多了解。

cues.en: How long does it take for a planet to kind of like reach maturity?
cues.zh: 一颗行星大概要多久才能成熟？

cues.en: Like, is it fully developed at this point, or is it still going to be evolving?
cues.zh: 也就是说，它现在已经完全形成，还是仍会继续演化？

cues.en: At this point, it's still very hot, and it possibly is still grabbing all the dust and gas that it can.
cues.zh: 目前它仍然非常炽热，可能还在吸收能吸收的尘埃和气体。

cues.en: And after about 10 million years, the big disc around the star will disappear, and we'll be left with the star and the planet.
cues.zh: 大约1000万年后，恒星周围的大盘会消失，只剩下恒星和行星。

cues.en: And just to give us a kind of a benchmark, what's the oldest planet that we've identified?
cues.zh: 作为一个参照，我们发现的最古老行星有多老？

cues.en: Oh my goodness, that's a question and a half.
cues.zh: 天啊，这可真是个问题。

cues.en: So most planets that we tend to look at are about the same age as our sun, maybe a little bit older.
cues.zh: 我们通常研究的行星，大多与太阳年龄相仿，可能还稍微古老一些。

cues.en: So they're between five and 10 billion years old.
cues.zh: 所以它们的年龄在50亿到100亿年之间。

cues.en: And does this help us then understand more about the early stages of planet formation?
cues.zh: 这能帮助我们更多了解行星形成的早期阶段吗？

cues.en: It really does. Finding objects within these gaps in the rings where we can see them really allows us to understand
cues.zh: 确实能。找到这些环中能看见的空隙内天体，真的能帮助我们理解

cues.en: whether our theory of planet formation is correct.
cues.zh: 我们的行星形成理论是否正确。

cues.en: And in this case, it looks like this planet is doing exactly what it should be doing at this age.
cues.zh: 在这个案例中，这颗行星似乎正在做它在这个年龄应该做的事。

cues.en: All of why a lot of us do this is to understand how unique our solar system is
cues.zh: 我们这样做，很大程度上是为了了解太阳系有多独特，

cues.en: and whether there are other solar systems out there that look like ours.
cues.zh: 以及宇宙中是否还有其他与我们相似的太阳系。

cues.en: And trying to understand the early stages of planet formation is a big part of that.
cues.zh: 努力理解行星形成的早期阶段，是其中重要的一部分。

cues.en: Sarah Casewell, astronomer and lecturer at Leicester University.
cues.zh: 萨拉·凯斯韦尔，莱斯特大学天文学家兼讲师。

cues.en: And that is all from us for now. But if you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 本期节目到此结束。如有意见，欢迎发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also watch our episodes in full by searching for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 你也可以在YouTube搜索Global News Podcast，观看完整节目。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Jack Wilfun and produced by Alice Adderley. Our editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 本期由杰克·威尔芬混音，爱丽丝·阿德利制作。编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I am Oliver Conway. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是奥利弗·康威。下期再见。
